beats.en: If a sheet is 0.001 cm thick, each fold doubles the thickness, so after 1 fold it is 0.002 cm, after 2 folds 0.004 cm and after 3 folds 0.008 cm.
beats.speakEn: If a sheet is 0.001 centimetres thick, each fold doubles the thickness, so after 1 fold it is 0.002 centimetres, after 2 folds 0.004 centimetres and after 3 folds 0.008 centimetres.

beats.en: After 10 folds the thickness is only 1.024 cm, after 17 folds about 131 cm, after 30 folds about 10.7 km, and after 46 folds more than 7,00,000 km.
beats.speakEn: After 10 folds the thickness is only 1.024 centimetres, after 17 folds about 131 centimetres, after 30 folds about 10.7 km, and after 46 folds more than 7,00,000 km.

textbookBox.concept: This repeated doubling is called multiplicative or exponential growth, and it explodes far faster than adding the same amount each time.

beats.en: We write repeated multiplication with a power: 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 2⁴, where 2 is the base and 4 is the exponent.
